records.description: 财报电话会议是一款专注于 美股上市公司电话会议内容中英翻译与解读的平台，通过领先的 AI 技术，实时翻译与结构化呈现美股公司 Earnings Call、Investor Call、Conference Call 等英文原文内容，帮助中文投资者、分析师与研究者完整理解财报核心信息、管理层观点与最新业务展望。 与市场上常见的英文摘要或关键词提取工具不同，财报电话会议支持全文级翻译 + 要点整理 + 中英对照输出，覆盖： 管理层业绩讲解与问答环节中英对照 财务指标、市场趋势、增长驱动与风险点清晰呈现 支持按公司、季度、行业快速检索与比较 该平台主要面向中文投资者生态，将 美股电话会议这一高价值信息源 转化为可读可用的中文智能内容，大幅降低语言门槛并提高投资理解效率。 核心覆盖关键词： 美股财报电话会议、AI 翻译、Earnings Call、Conference Call、投资研究、电话会议解读

records.name: Notion-EOS Business Operating System
records.tagline: Run entire business on Notion with EOS compatible OS
records.description: Stop drowning in operational chaos. This EOS-compatible Notion template gives you a complete business OS-sales CRM, marketing hub, HR systems, finance tracking, and client delivery-all in one workspace. Built from 3+ years scaling SMBs. Includes AI-powered SOP generation, business analyst AI agent, 20+ templates, and personal dashboards. Trusted by 100+ companies including Inc. 5000 teams. Works on Notion's free plan. Launch today.

records.name: Create Viral Faceless Shorts!
records.tagline: Automate your Faceless Channel: Create, Edit, and Post 24/7.
records.description: Building a faceless channel requires consistency, but manual editing creates burnout. Meet GetShorts, the all-in-one automation tool that runs your channel for you. What’s new in this update? We’ve added "Director-Level" control so your videos never feels generic: - Fine-tune exactly how your automated series runs. - Define your own aesthetic for consistent branding. - Manually adjust pan, zoom, and camera shake effects for every scene. - Upload your own music tracks to stand out from the crowd

records.name: ToolsGate
records.tagline: ToolsGate: Fast, Free Web Tools. No Registration Required.
records.description: ToolsGate is a fast, free web toolkit for daily tasks. 🚀 No registration or accounts required. We offer high-quality image compression, PDF tools, and more—all running directly in your browser. 💻 Privacy-focused and 100% free, ToolsGate simplifies your digital life without hidden costs or subscriptions. Perfect for designers, developers, and everyone needing quick solutions. Check it out at toolsgate.pro and let us know your feedback! 🛠️

records.name: ResumeForge
records.tagline: ATS FRIENDLY RESUME MAKER
records.description: Build a professional resume for free without signing up! Our ATS-friendly resume builder creates resumes that pass 95% of applicant tracking systems. 8 free templates including Executive & Creative, cover letter generator, instant PDF download. Join 50,000+ job seekers today!

records.name: Advance
records.tagline: اكسب من عملك عن بعد
records.description: عن تطبيق Advance تم تطوير تطبيق Advance ليكون منصة ذكية لتنفيذ المهام والتفاعل مع المحتوى داخل بيئة منظمة وسهلة الاستخدام، حيث يعتمد التطبيق على نظام إنجاز المهام والتفاعل المباشر من المستخدم وفق القواعد الموضحة داخل التطبيق. ✔️ تجربة استخدام واضحة ومنظمة ✔️ نظام وقت محدد لكل مهمة لضمان الانضباط وسهولة المتابعة ✔️ واجهة استخدام بسيطة ومناسبة للمبتدئين ✔️ تصميم منظم يسهّل التنقل بين الأقسام المختلفة ومتابعة التقدم داخل المنصة نشكرك علي استخدام متجاتنا

records.name: AI Baby Dance
records.tagline: Turn a single photo into a dancing video in minutes.
records.description: AI Baby Dance turns one photo into a short dancing video. Choose a style template (cute, funny, K‑pop, hip‑hop), pick 720p or 1080p, generate a preview, and download an MP4 ready for TikTok, Reels, or Shorts. Fast, mobile‑friendly, and no editing required.

records.name: AI Image to X/Twitter-CompleteAutomation
records.tagline: Generate AI images and auto-post to X in 30 seconds
records.description: Automate AI image generation and X/Twitter posting in 30 seconds. - DALL-E 3 generates images - GPT-4 creates captions - Smart hashtags - Auto-posts via Buffer Manual process: 5 minutes per post With this tool: 30 seconds Includes: - n8n workflow - Next.js app - Setup guides - 7-day support $49 Early Bird (first 50) $79 Regular Perfect for content creators and AI enthusiasts. Battle-tested: 3+ months, 100% uptime.

records.name: Griit
records.tagline: simple and fast translation with grammar
records.description: Griit is an AI translation tool that goes beyond word-for-word conversion. Get instant translations with detailed grammar explanation and vocabulary breakdowns. Key Features: • Real-time streaming translations • Learning Notes with vocabulary and gramma patterns • Alternative translation suggestions • Image translation (paste screenshots) • Translation history Perfect for language learners who want to undertand not just what something means, but why it's traslated that way.

records.name: AI Music Maker-Generate Song from Text
records.tagline: Royalty-Free AI Music for YouTube, TikTok & Streams Fast
records.description: AI Music Maker is the ultimate AI music generator for creators. Turn text prompts or lyrics into studio-quality, royalty-free music in seconds! 🚀 Key Features: • Text-to-Music: Generate full songs, melodies, and vocals automatically. • Copyright-Safe: Clear commercial licensing for YouTube, TikTok, and Twitch. • Versatile Genres: Lo-fi, EDM, Cinematic, and more for any content. Stop worrying about copyright strikes. Create unique soundtracks with MusicMakerApp.com today!
